hero.title: About My12Photos
hero.subtitle: Discover a global photography community where creativity is celebrated, stories are shared, and talented photographers compete for monthly recognition and cash prizes.

story.title: Our Story
story.p1: My12Photos was created with a simple idea—to give photographers of every skill level a place to showcase their creativity, tell visual stories, and gain recognition. Unlike traditional photo-sharing platforms, My12Photos brings photographers together through exciting monthly competitions, transparent voting, and a supportive global community.
story.p2: Whether you're capturing breathtaking landscapes, unforgettable moments, or creative storytelling through albums, our platform helps your work reach a wider audience.
story.quote: Every photographer should have a fair stage to present their visual timeline. We designed My12Photos as that global amphitheater.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.p1: Our mission is to inspire creativity by providing a modern, fair, and engaging photography competition platform where every photographer has an equal opportunity to be recognized.
mission.p2: We aim to make photography competitions simple, transparent, and enjoyable while rewarding participants for their passion and creativity.
mission.highlight: Fair Play, Transparent Voting & High Engagement

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.p1: We aspire to become one of the world's leading online photography competition platforms, connecting photographers from around the globe and building a vibrant community driven by creativity, recognition, and continuous participation.

howItWorks.title: How Our Competitions Work
howItWorks.subtitle: Follow our simple, streamlined timeline to submit your art, gather votes, and claim monthly recognition. Click each step below to learn more!
howItWorks.s1summary: Sign up for free and complete your profile.
howItWorks.s1detailTitle: Sign up for free and complete your profile.
howItWorks.s1detailBody: Set up your personal gallery, link your photography socials, and tell the community about your artistic style.
howItWorks.s2summary: Select one of our competition categories.
howItWorks.s2detailTitle: Pick the album format that fits your story.
howItWorks.s2detailBody: Enter Single Photo, 6-Photo Story, or the full 12-photo Zodiac Album — each with its own prizes and monthly theme.
howItWorks.s3summary: Submit your best photographs before the monthly deadline.
howItWorks.s3detailBody: Upload high-quality images that match the competition rules. You can refine captions and sequence until submissions close.
howItWorks.s4summary: Your submission becomes available for public voting.
howItWorks.s4detailBody: Once live in the gallery, your work is open for transparent community voting throughout the competition window.
howItWorks.s5summary: Top-ranked photographers receive recognition, awards, and prizes.
howItWorks.s5detailBody: Top-ranked photographers receive recognition, awards, and monthly cash prizes — with winners featured across the platform.

community.title: Our Community
community.body: Our growing community consists of photographers, storytellers, hobbyists, and photography enthusiasts from around the world. Members can explore inspiring galleries, discover talented artists, participate in competitions, and celebrate each month's winners together.
community.belief: We believe every photograph tells a story, and every story deserves an audience.
community.exchangeText: Connect with visual minds across 150+ countries.
community.critiqueText: Acquire helpful reviews and votes from peers.
